Overview
Apply your software development education and experience as a member of our software development team. You will build and release Esri software technologies focused on the intersection between GIS, photogrammetry and remote sensing for the defense and intelligence communities. In this role, you will collaborate with a talented team of software developers and product engineers to create, build, test, and release advanced software technologies focused on imagery users. This is an exciting opportunity to focus your programming skills on designing and building powerful tools to support a wide variety of analytical workflows and imagery sources (such as MS and HSI, TIR, RADAR, LiDAR, Motion Imagery, and other remotely sensed data and information).
Responsibilities
System Design, Software Architecture, and Software Implementation of Esri's GIS Software Products
Utilize a strong understanding of the user requirements to motivate the design and implementation of the systems they work on, as well as a strong understanding of GIS and Geospatial Technology
Participate in the development of ArcGIS software products by writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code
Define, implement, maintain, and document software code architecture, algorithms, and data structures
Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to identify requirements for development of products, features, fixes, functionality, and/or capabilities
Translate software requirements into technical specifications
Write and participate in code reviews of software code written by self and others to ensure quality code is merged into the software following coding standards
Maintain code in a comprehensive shared repository. Analyze and repair software defects
Collaborate with engineers to develop and execute comprehensive test plans and ensure software quality
Plan and execute software development projects following software development methodologies
Stay current in existing and emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices
Requirements
One (1) year of experience in the job offered, or one (1) year of experience in a related occupation
Must demonstrate experience in Java, Servlets, JSP, TLS and PKI, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and REST
Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent degree, in Computer Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field
Recommended Qualifications

Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

Sony Interactive Entertainment has an extraordinary opportunity in the Tools, Framework and Infrastructure team! We are looking for a motivated and creative individual to help build test tools, frameworks, and infrastructure for delivering high quality software which drives the PlayStation experience.
As a Software Engineer II, you'll focus on building test frameworks and infrastructure, internal tools, and automating test workflows. You will collaborate closely with Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams to build robust systems to ensure products delivered to customers and game studios are of the highest quality.
Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain test frameworks, tooling and infrastructure for teams which develop and test software for the Playstation console.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar tools.
Collaborate with Quality and Development teams to enable testing of both hardware and software components in isolation.
Construct telemetry systems and dashboard in order to make data-driven decisions about technical feature development.
Build tooling for AI-driven testing initiatives
Required Qualifications
Master’s degree in Computer science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields
2+ years experience in designing, developing and maintaining tools and applications in C++, Python, or Javascript with a focus on building testing tools, and test frameworks at scale. (C++, JS experience preferred)
Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g. Appium, Mocha.js, etc.)
Demonstrated experience building and deploying high availability and high reliability services from scratch.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems like Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar tools.
Comfortable working in Linux and Windows-based development environments.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with engineering and QA teams.
Hands-on experience applying LLM and Agentic AI in practical engineering contexts such as test case generation, flaky test detection, log analysis, or workflow automation.
Strong debugging skills.
Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with test/build automation on PCs, consoles or other embedded systems
Familiarity with Node, React Native/Web, Kubernetes, REST APIs
Experience with testing audio peripherals (headphones, earbuds, microphones) or input devices (controllers).
Working knowledge Docker-based test environments.
Game industry background
Exposure to integrating or building tools powered by large language models
Japanese Language familiarity a plus
